title: Blocodex
description: Catch every block of the game !
body:
# Blocodex
Blocodex turns Minecraft into a living library of blocks and items to discover, catalog, through a dedicated Dex.

Inspired by projects like **Completionist’s Index**, **Age of Engineering**, and **Evolving Technology**, Blocodex takes the concept of a collectible catalog and applies it to a clearer, experience focused entirely on exploring the game’s blocks.

The goal is simple: **discover, unlock, and track your progress** through a true block codex—like a personal encyclopedia of your Minecraft world.

Compatible with mods ! 

You can use it in your modpacks.
